definitions.gloss: aesthetic eye; eye for beauty; discerning taste
definitions.explanation: The ability to recognize and appreciate what is beautiful or of high quality. Used for people who have refined taste in art, design, fashion, or craftsmanship.

examples.japanese: {審美眼|しんびがん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{養|やしな}う→養う：04478_yashinau⟧。
examples.english: To cultivate an eye for beauty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れた→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧{審美眼|しんびがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧だ。
examples.english: He has an excellent eye for beauty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本物|ほんもの}→本物：03628_honmono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{芸術|げいじゅつ}→芸術：02712_geijutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|ふ}れる→触れる：01984_fureru⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{審美眼|しんびがん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{磨|みが}かれる→磨く：02427_migaku⟧。
examples.english: By experiencing genuine art, one's aesthetic sensibility is refined.

notes: Composed of {審美|しんび} (aesthetics, appreciation of beauty) + {眼|がん} (eye, discernment). Common collocations: {審美眼|しんびがん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{養|やしな}う→養う：04478_yashinau⟧ (to cultivate an aesthetic eye), {審美眼|しんびがん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧ (to refine one's eye for beauty), {審美眼|しんびがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧ (a person with an eye for beauty). A somewhat literary or formal word. Related: ⟦{目利|めき}き→目利き：18598_mekiki⟧ (connoisseur, expert judge) is more colloquial.
